plain_language_summary: Hydrogen water contains dissolved molecular hydrogen gas in drinking water.
educational_notes: Hydrogen water is different from ordinary filtered water because the focus is dissolved molecular hydrogen, not only filtration or taste.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not medical advice.

plain_language_summary: PPB means parts per billion and is commonly used to describe dissolved molecular hydrogen concentration.
educational_notes: In hydrogen water education, 1000 PPB equals 1 PPM. A 10000 PPB reference equals 10 PPM.
safety_framing: Hydrogen concentration claims should be understood as product or testing references, not medical claims.

plain_language_summary: Hydrogen water bottles are designed to generate or infuse molecular hydrogen into drinking water.
educational_notes: Bottle design, cycle time, water type, and maintenance may affect the user experience.
safety_framing: Follow device instructions. Use clean drinking water and maintain the bottle properly.

plain_language_summary: Hydrogen water and alkaline water are not the same. Hydrogen water focuses on dissolved molecular hydrogen, while alkaline water focuses on pH.
educational_notes: Some products may discuss both, but molecular hydrogen concentration and pH are separate concepts.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Avoid assuming alkaline water and hydrogen water provide the same function.

plain_language_summary: Hydrogen water may be used as part of a daily hydration routine.
educational_notes: Hydrogen water should support normal hydration habits and should not replace a balanced lifestyle or medical care.
safety_framing: People with medical conditions or fluid restrictions should follow professional healthcare guidance.

plain_language_summary: Hydrogen water bottles should be cleaned and maintained according to the product instructions.
educational_notes: Regular cleaning helps support taste, hygiene, and device performance.
safety_framing: Avoid harsh chemicals unless specifically allowed by the product instructions.

plain_language_summary: Portable hydrogen water bottles are commonly used for travel, work, gym routines, and daily hydration habits.
educational_notes: Convenience is a major reason consumers explore hydrogen water bottles.
safety_framing: Use the bottle as directed and avoid misuse, overheating, or improper charging.

plain_language_summary: Beginners should understand the difference between molecular hydrogen concentration, water quality, pH, and bottle maintenance.
educational_notes: Hydrogen water education should avoid disease-treatment claims and focus on hydration, device understanding, and responsible use.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, cure, or prevention.
